terms.ru: Неправильные и необычные формы множественного числа

en.title: Irregular and unusual plurals
en.summary: A few common English nouns have plurals that do not follow the -s rule.

paragraphs: A few very common English nouns have plurals that do not follow the -s rule. Most come from older forms of the language. Because these nouns are frequent, you will use them every day, so learn them as pairs.

Some nouns change the vowel, such as man and men. Some nouns do not change at all, such as sheep, fish and deer. Some words from Latin or Greek keep their original plural, such as analysis and analyses. Some nouns are always plural, such as scissors and trousers.
Things with two parts are plural: scissors, trousers, glasses, jeans. To count them we use a pair of: a pair of scissors. Words such as news and mathematics end in -s but are singular.
Some words keep a foreign plural in careful writing: criteria, bacteria, phenomena, cacti. Others have a regular plural in everyday use. We say formulas or formulae, and both are correct.

items: Wrong: **a scissors** Right: **a pair of scissors**

ro.title: Pluraluri neregulate și neobișnuite
ro.summary: Unele substantive românești au forme neobișnuite la plural sau își păstrează aceeași formă.

paragraphs: În limba română, cele mai multe substantive au terminații regulate la plural. Totuși, câteva cuvinte foarte folosite au forme neașteptate. Aceste forme speciale provin din istoria limbii.

items: Văd un **om** pe stradă și mulți **oameni** în parc.
Ea are o **soră**, iar el are două **surori**.
Avem un singur **nume**, dar ei au două **nume**.

paragraphs: Unele cuvinte își schimbă mult literele din interior sau primesc terminații neobișnuite. Alte substantive au exact aceeași formă la singular și plural. Câteva substantive se folosesc exclusiv la plural.
